name: Sir Keith Park Station
scope: Mapped position of the small Sir Keith Park Station shelter on the MOTAT heritage railway, with its rail-facing entrance, station board, bench and immediate platform apron.
era: The surviving heritage station with its exterior as pictured in March 2008.

references.caption: The 'train station' at the Museum of Transport and Technology in Auckland City, New Zealand. It serves a relatively short museum-internal railroad track. Tree in centre is a Cupressus sempervirens.

originalReview.notes: Inspected the exact original JPG published in the story. The Commons record identifies it as Ingolfson’s own work, released into the public domain, with a matching native SHA-1. The rails, chain link, trees and area beyond the apron remain site context.
